speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

speckit-evolve.name: Evolve Task with OpenEvolve
speckit-evolve.description: Prepares OpenEvolve artifacts from spec-kit artifacts for a single task, gates for manual OpenEvolve run, then integrates the best result back into the codebase and verifies the test suite.

speckit-full.name: Full SDD Pipeline
speckit-full.description: Runs the complete Spec-Driven Development pipeline: constitution → specify → clarify → plan → checklist → analyze → tasks → thinking → implement → evolve. Includes human review gates after clarify, after thinking, and after implement. The analyze gate is agent-evaluated: auto-continues on APPROVED, pauses on BLOCKED.
